I deliberately avoid promotional_pricing despite competitive pressure: memory_73 already documents a clear pattern (SMB discount driving short-term signups/revenue but -12% retention at renewal), which conflicts with the primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue; chasing the competitor's price war would likely trade durable value for a short-term metric bump.
